blurb: G2O Spa + Salon provides a range of spa and salon services including esthetician treatments, massage therapy, nail services, hair styling, and makeup artistry. The facility includes amenities such as a Lifestyle Retail Boutique, Fireside Lounge, Relaxation Lounge, Sauna, and complimentary beverages and snacks. Guests are encouraged to arrive 15-30 minutes early to enjoy these amenities and prepare for their services.
